answer: Track Your Life with Boyd Varty is Boyd Varty's five-day tracking and coaching retreat at Londolozi Pioneer Camp, filed by James Wild & Co.: four nights for men only, six at most, held four times a year between April and July. Coaching, tracking, two safaris a day and meals are included; wellness treatments, flights and charters are extra. Healing House treatments and two nights at Ellerman House can be added.

days.title: Johannesburg to Pioneer Camp
days.line: By road to Londolozi · time on request
days.body: By road from Johannesburg (OR Tambo): the N12 and N4 east to Nelspruit, the R40 through White River to Hazyview, then the R536 towards Paul Kruger Gate. About 37 km along it, a gravel road turns off to the Sabi Sand's Shaws Gate, where the reserve charges an entry fee per person and per vehicle. From the gate it is about 17 km to camp, following Londolozi's signs.

faqs: What is Track Your Life with Boyd Varty?
Boyd Varty's five-day tracking and coaching retreat at Londolozi Pioneer Camp: four nights, for men only, six at most.
Four a year, between April and July. We confirm the dates for the year you want to go.
Coaching, tracking, two safaris a day and meals. Wellness treatments, flights and charters are extra.
Can I add Healing House treatments?
Yes, at extra cost. The Healing House is at Londolozi's Varty Camp.
Can I add Cape Town after the retreat?
Yes. Two nights at Ellerman House in Cape Town can follow, by air from Londolozi.
It is a low-risk malaria area. Precautions are still advised; ask your doctor before you travel.
How much does the retreat cost?
It is quoted against your dates, with any current offer applied. James Wild & Co does not publish a fixed price for it.
related: Londolozi, Ellerman House and Leeu Estates: the house's South Africa route.
